thesis: CRVL is an uptrend (close 83.16 above SMA20 82.11, SMA50 76.13, SMA200 62.85) pulling back to its SMA20 after an earnings week. The price response to the print was net positive (11-04 gapped up from 82.64 to open 85.41 and closed 87.38), which partly answers the bear's unknown-print concern, and fundamentals are high quality with accelerating growth. It is not a tech name in a tech-led risk-off tape, but the rich multiple, the failed push at 89.76, and the missing news feed cap conviction, so this is Overweight rather than Buy.
invalidation: A daily close below 78.9 (under the 79.19 earnings-day swing low) voids the setup; a close below the SMA50 at 76.13 breaks the uptrend.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.9, QQQ 21-day -12.24%, VIX percentile 0.876) can de-rate a rich multiple (trailing P/E 34.9, EV/EBITDA 20.2)
